events.text: July-September 2026 Summary July - September 2026 * Net sales amounted to SEK 175.0 (146.6) million, an increase of 19.4 per cent compared with the same period last year. CEO Comments A record quarter demonstrates the scalability of our business I am proud and truly delighted to present the strongest quarter in MSAB’s history. When I joined the company, I saw outstanding products, a strong market position and significant untapped potential for growth. Together with a new management team, we established a clear strategy, convinced that the right investments would turn that potential into growth within 12 to 24 months. Since then, we have executed our plan with focus and consistency, and today we are seeing the results. The quarter delivered record revenue and our highest profitability ever. Net sales amounted to SEK 175.0 million, an increase of 19.4 per cent compared with the same period last year, and currency-adjusted growth was 17.6 per cent. Operating profit (EBIT) amounted to SEK 72.0 million, corresponding to an operating margin of 41.1 per cent. The consistent execution of our strategy, combined with the scalability of our business model, is now delivering both higher revenue and strong profitability. Customer loyalty supports long-term growth This quarter reflects the underlying strength of our business. At its core are long-standing customer relationships built on trust, close collaboration and consistently high-quality solutions. Customers who choose MSAB tend to stay with us, which reflects both the strength of our offering and the expertise of our teams. This high level of customer loyalty generates recurring business and provides a solid foundation for future growth. During the quarter, we also secured a significant agreement with a military customer in Europe, an important step in expanding our presence in the defence sector. By sharpening our customer focus, broadening our expertise and investing in the areas that matter most to our customers, we see continued opportunities for sustainable growth. Product innovation strengthens our technological leadership Improving our extraction capabilities and further developing our offering for both Android and iOS remain our highest priority. These areas are central to our product roadmap and to our ability to keep pace with increasingly complex devices and operating systems. Over the coming year, we plan to increase our investment in development to accelerate innovation and remain at the forefront in our field. The continued development of XRY Pro and our broader product portfolio strengthens our role as a trusted technology partner to law enforcement agencies and other public sector customers. Our strong global position was recognised when MSAB was named one of only three global “Leaders” in the “IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Digital Forensics Platforms 2026 Vendor Assessment”. adviser.thesis:
# MSAB-B
**Aktuell tes (2026-10-26):** Q3 var ett rekordkvartal, men nu finns en ny risk. Efter stängning 2026-10-26 (MFN 17:45) meddelade bolaget att ett intrång hos en kund har lett till att en äldre version av XRY Pro kopieras och säljs utan licens. Bolaget säger att det inte påverkar affären kommersiellt och att versionen blir obrukbar inom några månader. Samma dag (MFN 13:00) meddelades att teknikchefen Anders Jonson lämnar; enligt bolaget utan koppling till intrånget. Ingen efterträdare är utsedd.
Skuggvikt: modellens (1,17 %), HOLD. Jag säljer inte i förväg, eftersom börsens reaktion 2026-10-27 kommer före min affär.
Motbevis (bear): kunder eller myndigheter pausar sina köp, eller kursen faller mer än 20 % från 112,76 inom 60 dagar. Motbevis (bull): försäljningstillväxten i Q4 är minst 10 % trots händelsen.
Övertygelse: låg (volatiliteten är 57 %, och det finns ny ryktesrisk hos myndighetskunder).

## Historik
- 2026-10-27: Kursen 109,11, -4,1 % på veckan och en mild reaktion på de två PM:en. Skuggvikten höjs från 1,17 % till 4 % (REDUCE mot modellens 6,6 %) som del av upprampningen till modellens aktieandel. Motbevisen är oförändrade.
- 2026-10-23: Tesen skapad, kurs 113,81. Rekord-Q3: försäljning 175 MSEK (+19 %), EBIT-marginal 41 %. Svagt kassaflöde (3 MSEK). Planerad skuggvikt 1,5 % låstes aldrig.
- 2026-10-26: Teknikchefen lämnar, och licensintrånget gör att XRY Pro sprids utan licens. Kurs 112,76. Vikten sänks till modellens, och WARN-larm.
